newsitem.title: USA: Primark unit launches trading indexes.
newsitem.headline: Primark unit launches trading indexes.

text.p: Primark Corp said Monday its Disclosure Inc unit launched a series of trading indexes.
Primark said the indexes measure executive sentiment and catalog and analyze the about 5,000 weekly "insider" SEC filings.

It said the indexes are published weekly through Global Access, Disclosure's online service. The company said Disclosure has processed all "insider" filings on behalf of the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission since June, 1996.
